scientific_integrity: Analytical Perron-eigenvalue and renewal-reward proof; exact algebraic witness; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric equal-size two groups, step-function immunity, Erlang-2 or exponential inter-booster renewals, fixed per-capita dose rate; one nonlocal Erlang-2 witness; no general global optimum or nonlinear epidemic-dynamics theorem.
title: A sharp fairness threshold and a nonlocal reversal for two-stage vaccination renewal
